name: Suzumiya Ha*hi no Shousoku
source:
A doujin visual novel where Konata from "Lucky Star" goes to the world of "The Melancholy of Suzumiya Haruhi" and Haruhi goes to the world of "Lucky Star".

[Translated from [url=http://kbyschool.g.ribbon.to/index.html]The Official Site[/url]]
translation:
一部同人视觉小说：《幸运☆星》的泉此方来到《凉宫春日的忧郁》的世界，凉宫春日则来到《幸运☆星》的世界。

[翻译自[url=http://kbyschool.g.ribbon.to/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
